To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a single shot text detector can directly output word level detection in a natural image and (2) an attention mechanism is a powerful technique to suppress background noise in convolutional features, enabling the detector to work on extremely small text.

we develop a single shot text detector, that is based on an attention mechanism, a hierarchical inception module, and a multi scale bounding box regression, which achieves state of the art accuracy in detecting multi scale and multi oriented text.
We present a single shot text detector, which is a simple and fast model that directly outputs word-level bounding boxes.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: How to effectively suppress background interference in convolutional feature maps? How to efficiently aggregate multi-scale convolutional features to achieve a robust text detection? How to achieve a single shot text detector?
the problem of detecting text in natural scenes.
the problem of detecting text in natural images.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper presents a new approach for detecting text in images, and that it outperforms existing approaches on the ICDA 2015 benchmark dataset.
our method is the best in the world for detecting text in the wild, and we are very happy with this.
the proposed method is a state of the art text detection method, which is the first of its kind.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present an end to end trainable single shot text detector which directly predicts word level bounding boxes without any post processing.
we present a novel single model based text detector that works on a single scale image.
we present the first single shot text detector which works on single scale images, and achieves state of the art accuracy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed attention mechanism can be applied to other tasks, e.g., face detection, object detection.
the proposed single shot text detector can achieve comparable accuracy to the best performing multi model text detectors.
the attention mechanism can be a powerful tool to help single shot object detectors work reliably in a single scale image.
